LanguageData.BRW.ZPMDischarge.Title: ZPM Meltdown
LanguageData.BRW.ZPMDischarge.Letter:
ZPM Containment Breach
The Zero Point Module's quantum vacuum extraction chamber has suffered a catastrophic containment failure: The Zero‑Point Module was left unshielded beneath open sky.
The ZPM's naquadah-enhanced control crystals have been severely damaged by the quantum backlash, requiring extensive repairs before the device can safely resume zero-point energy extraction operations.
LanguageData.BRW.ZPM.Discharge.Warning: The {0} is suffering from atmospheric exposure and may discharge catastrophically!
LanguageData.BRW.ZPM.InducedSolarFlare.Title: ZPM‑Induced Solar Flare
LanguageData.BRW.ZPM.InducedSolarFlare:
ZPM‑Induced Solar Flare
The Zero‑Point Module was left unshielded beneath open sky. Its quantum‑vacuum conduits phase‑locked with the system star’s magnetosphere, triggering an artificial coronal mass ejection.
Mitigation:
1. Re‑roof or relocate the module to a fully enclosed, roofed room. 2. Wait out the flare ({0}). 3. Repair damaged crystals before re‑activation.
